title: Afgeronde workout hervatten (CONTINUE RIDE) -> nieuwe samples komen erbij, live backup loopt, opslaan = langer

steps.name: live backup heeft de nieuwe samples
opgeslagen: zelfde rit, langer, afgerond
steps.assert: fetch('/api/vbt/rides?limit=200',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('hp_token')}}).then(r=>r.json()).then(a => { const r = a.filter(x => x.clientId === window.__r.clientId); window.__dbg = JSON.stringify(r.map(x => [x.duration, x.inProgress])) + ' was ' + window.__r.duration; return r.length === 1 && !r[0].inProgress && r[0].duration >= window.__r.duration + 15 })
